title.narrative: Renforcement des services humanitaires d'urgence en matière de nutrition et de protection pour répondre aux besoins les plus immédiats des enfants.

description.narrative: The main objective of this UNICEF project is to strengthen the provision of life-saving nutritional services for children under five, pregnant and breastfeeding women, while improving children's access to emergency protection services in targeted areas. The project provides nutritional service with high quality, individual counseling and/or community awareness sessions on infant and young child feeding, effective leadership for the coordination of the nutrition cluster, mental health and psychosocial support to protect the children affected by humanitarian crisis and establishment of community-based child protection mechanisms. The intervention provides humanitarian assistance to 37,000 people (7,480 men, 14,520 women and 15,000 children), including 1,220 persons with disabilities.
